journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control

articles.title_en: Racial unemployment gaps and the disparate impact of the inflation tax in a new monetarist model
articles.title_cn: 种族失业差距与通货膨胀税在新货币主义模型中的差异性影响
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the disparate effects of the inflation tax on welfare and the racial unemployment gap between Black and white workers in a New Monetarist model with heterogeneity in labor market and payment frictions. A calibrated version of the model is able to replicate the difference between the two groups in both the level and the volatility of unemployment. Higher trend inflation increases both the level of the racial unemployment gap and the magnitude of its response to shocks. Relative to the Friedman rule, 10% trend inflation reduces welfare by 8.83% for Black households versus 7.39% for white households. Labor market heterogeneity accounts for most of the disparity, while differences in access to credit are less important but have nontrivial general equilibrium effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了在一个包含劳动力市场异质性和支付摩擦的新货币主义模型中，通货膨胀税对福利以及黑人与白人工人之间种族失业差距的差异性影响。模型的校准版本能够复现两组在失业水平及其波动性上的差异。较高的趋势通货膨胀既提高了种族失业差距的水平，也增大了其对冲击的响应幅度。相对于弗里德曼规则，10%的趋势通货膨胀使黑人家庭的福利减少了8.83%，而白人家庭则减少了7.39%。劳动力市场的异质性解释了大部分差距，而信贷获取方面的差异虽然不那么重要，但具有不可忽视的一般均衡效应。

articles.title_en: The building blocks of inflation: The role of monetary policy and the gap between goods and services
articles.title_cn: 通胀的构建模块：货币政策的作用与商品和服务之间的差距
articles.abstract_en: I build and estimate a three-region structural macroeconomic model with a goods, services, housing and oil sector. The model also has meaningful household portfolio decisions over foreign and domestic bond holdings and financial intermediation to investigate the efficacy of large-scale asset purchases (LSAP) by a central bank. The model is built and estimated to ensure that the potential causes that have been pointed to as a reason for the global inflation seen in the COVID recovery economy are accounted for. Examining the dynamics of the model, LSAPs conducted in an economy with relative high demand for goods rather than services will lead to a bigger expansionary and inflationary impact than in an economy where demand for services is relatively higher than goods. I also find that LSAPs are more expansionary and inflationary when the service sector is incurring supply shocks. These findings help us understand why LSAPs conducted in the global financial crisis had such a different impact than those conducted in the COVID economy.
articles.abstract_cn: 我构建并估计了一个包含商品、服务、住房和石油部门的三区域结构宏观经济模型。该模型还包含家庭在外国和国内债券持有以及金融中介方面的有意义的投资组合决策，以研究中央银行大规模资产购买（LSAP）的有效性。模型的构建和估计旨在确保那些被指为COVID复苏经济中全球通胀原因的潜在因素得到考虑。通过考察模型的动态，相对于服务需求，商品需求相对较高的经济体实施的LSAP将比服务需求相对高于商品的经济体产生更大的扩张性和通胀性影响。我还发现，当服务部门遭受供给冲击时，LSAP更具扩张性和通胀性。这些发现有助于我们理解为什么在全球金融危机期间实施的LSAP与在COVID经济中实施的LSAP产生了如此不同的影响。

articles.title_en: US monetary policy uncertainty spillover and the role of exchange rate regime
articles.title_cn: 美国货币政策不确定性溢出与汇率制度的作用
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the international spillover effects of US monetary policy uncertainty shocks on countries with fixed versus flexible exchange rate regimes. Our findings show that such shocks lead to a larger contraction in countries with flexible exchange rates than in those with fixed exchange rates, contradicting the conventional view that flexible exchange rates serve as a buffer against external shocks. We also document that US monetary policy uncertainty shocks raise economic uncertainty more strongly in countries with flexible exchange rate regimes. On the theoretical side, we demonstrate that a standard small open economy New Keynesian DSGE model cannot replicate this empirical result, but an augmented model that incorporates the direct international spillover of policy uncertainty is able to reproduce the findings.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了美国货币政策不确定性冲击对固定汇率制度与浮动汇率制度国家的国际溢出效应。我们的研究结果表明，此类冲击导致浮动汇率制度国家的经济收缩幅度大于固定汇率制度国家，这与浮动汇率作为外部冲击缓冲器的传统观点相悖。我们还记录到，美国货币政策不确定性冲击在浮动汇率制度国家更强烈地提高了经济不确定性。在理论方面，我们证明标准的小型开放经济新凯恩斯主义DSGE模型无法复制这一实证结果，但纳入政策不确定性直接国际溢出的扩展模型能够重现这些发现。

articles.title_en: Forecasting Chinese equity premium: A dimensionality reduction combination approach
articles.title_cn: 预测中国股权溢价：一种降维组合方法
articles.abstract_en: Using a high-dimensional dataset comprising 993 macroeconomic predictors, we develop a dimensionality reduction combination forecast framework to examine the out-of-sample predictability of the Chinese equity premium. We compare forecasts across two aspects: (1) 14 predictor groups versus the full set, and (2) 15 individual dimensionality reduction models versus three combination methods. Our findings indicate that the full set offers richer information and that combining forecasts across dimensionality reduction models yields statistically and economically out-of-sample gains. Encompassing tests and MSPE decomposition explain the benefits of the dimensionality reduction combination forecast. These findings survive a series of robustness checks.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用包含993个宏观经济预测变量的高维数据集，我们开发了一种降维组合预测框架，以检验中国股权溢价的样本外可预测性。我们从两个方面比较预测：（1）14个预测变量组与完整集合，（2）15个单独的降维模型与三种组合方法。我们的研究结果表明，完整集合提供了更丰富的信息，并且跨降维模型组合预测在统计和经济上均带来了样本外收益。包含检验和MSPE分解解释了降维组合预测的优势。这些发现在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。

articles.title_en: Monetary policy surprises: Robust dynamic causal effects
articles.title_cn: 货币政策冲击：稳健的动态因果效应
articles.abstract_en: We build on the Local Projection Instrumental Variable (LP-IV) approach to assess the effects of a monetary policy shock on the US economy, focusing on inference. We pay particular attention to the specification of control variables that warrant exogeneity of instruments. We introduce a response parameter that is always identified despite missing controls. Simulation results reveal that the standard LP-IV approach yields severe over-rejections as control requirements are relaxed, in contrast to our procedure which controls size and has good power. Empirical results are robust to expanded credit spreads data and to various competing instruments building on High Frequency Identification.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们基于局部投影工具变量（LP-IV）方法评估货币政策冲击对美国经济的影响，重点关注推断问题。我们特别关注确保工具外生性的控制变量的设定。我们引入了一个即使在缺少控制变量时也能始终识别的响应参数。模拟结果表明，随着控制要求的放宽，标准的LP-IV方法会导致严重的过度拒绝，而我们的方法则能控制检验水平并具有良好的检验功效。实证结果对扩展的信用利差数据以及基于高频识别的各种竞争性工具均保持稳健。

articles.title_en: Real exchange rate dynamics and external balances: Econometric and artificial neural network analyses
articles.title_cn: 实际汇率动态和外部平衡：计量经济学和人工神经网络分析
articles.abstract_en: We examine the dynamic relationship between the real exchange rate (RER) and external balances using both econometric and artificial neural network (NN) approaches. Our framework synthesizes a vector error correction model (VECM) and an NN model derived from it. Unlike traditional models such as vector autoregression (VAR), our models systematically incorporate economic relationships pertinent to the subject matter. These includes (i) the stock-flow relationship between the stock of net foreign assets (NFA) and current account flows, and (ii) the long-run, cointegrating relationship between the RER and NFA. After validating the framework, we apply the VECM and NN model to U.S. data, considering the country’s substantial net foreign debt and the associated dollar adjustments. Our VECM results differ markedly from previous VAR studies, revealing previously unidentified dynamics and indicating that the NFA position drives the RER. Our NN model, which appropriately handles both stationary and nonstationary data, outperforms alternative models in forecasting RER movements. Both modeling approaches highlight the importance of properly incorporating stock I(1) variables through cointegration and error correction.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用计量经济学和人工神经网络（NN）方法研究实际汇率（RER）和外部平衡之间的动态关系。我们的框架综合了矢量误差校正模型（VECM）和从中派生的神经网络模型。与向量自回归 (VAR) 等传统模型不同，我们的模型系统地纳入了与主题相关的经济关系。其中包括 (i) 外国净资产 (NFA) 存量与经常账户流量之间的存量流量关系，以及 (ii) RER 与 NFA 之间的长期协整关系。验证框架后，我们将 VECM 和 NN 模型应用于美国数据，考虑到该国大量的净外债和相关的美元调整。我们的 VECM 结果与之前的 VAR 研究明显不同，揭示了之前未知的动态，并表明 NFA 头寸驱动 RER。我们的神经网络模型可以适当处理静态和非静态数据，在预测 RER 运动方面优于其他模型。两种建模方法都强调了通过协整和误差校正正确合并库存 I(1) 变量的重要性。

articles.title_en: Productive public spending, knowledge spillovers and convergence: A multi-country analysis
articles.title_cn: 生产性公共支出、知识溢出与收敛：一项多国分析
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a multi-country AK model of endogenous growth with international knowledge transmission to study the impact of productive public expenditure on growth and convergence. A leader advances the global technology frontier, and followers benefit from spillovers only once their knowledge reaches a threshold. Productive public expenditure helps followers reach this threshold; once attained, their growth rate converges to the leader’s and spillover gains taper as the gap closes. Using dynamic heterogeneous panel models, we find evidence for this mechanism: productive public expenditure lifts growth only for countries consistently below the threshold, spillovers peak at the threshold, and they fade as economies near the frontier.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个包含国际知识传播的多国AK内生增长模型，以研究生产性公共支出对增长和收敛的影响。领导者推进全球技术前沿，追随者只有在知识达到阈值后才能受益于溢出效应。生产性公共支出帮助追随者达到这一阈值；一旦达到，其增长率将收敛至领导者的水平，且随着差距缩小，溢出收益逐渐减弱。利用动态异质性面板模型，我们找到了支持这一机制的证据：生产性公共支出仅对持续低于阈值的国家提升增长，溢出效应在阈值处达到峰值，并随着经济体接近前沿而逐渐消退。

articles.title_en: From beliefs to prices: Analyzing how inflation expectations affect the inflation distribution
articles.title_cn: 从信念到价格：分析通胀预期如何影响通胀分布
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates how the distribution of inflation expectations influences realized inflation across its entire distribution. We find that shocks to median inflation expectations increase the median inflation rate for up to three years, and subsequently generate persistent upside risks in inflation that endure for more than six years. By analyzing higher-order moments; specifically, the standard deviation, skewness, and kurtosis of inflation expectations, we show that greater disagreement among agents has distinct impacts on the distribution of the inflation rate. While an increase in the standard deviation amplifies right-tail inflation risks and generates quantile-dependent effects at the 90th percentile of the inflation distribution, a negative skewness shock temporarily shifts the distribution without any quantile-dependent effects. In the long run, shocks to kurtosis have insignificant effects at lower quantiles, but significant effects at extremely upper quantiles. Furthermore, we show that the quantile dependence of the responses of inflation to shocks in the median and in the standard deviation of expectations is amplified when inflation is rising. Our results highlight the critical importance of the distributional properties of inflation expectations for understanding and managing inflation risks. The results also underscore the need for well-anchored expectations to promote macroeconomic price stability.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了通胀预期分布如何影响实际通胀的整个分布。我们发现，通胀预期中位数的冲击会在长达三年的时间内提高通胀率中位数，并随后产生持续超过六年的持久性通胀上行风险。通过分析高阶矩，特别是通胀预期的标准差、偏度和峰度，我们表明，主体之间更大的分歧对通胀率的分布具有不同的影响。虽然标准差的增加放大了右尾通胀风险，并在通胀分布的第90百分位产生分位数依赖效应，但负偏度冲击会暂时改变分布，而不产生任何分位数依赖效应。在长期中，峰度冲击在较低分位数处的影响不显著，但在极高分数位处的影响显著。此外，我们表明，当通胀上升时，通胀对预期中位数和预期标准差冲击的反应的分位数依赖性会被放大。我们的结果凸显了通胀预期的分布特性对于理解和管理通胀风险的关键重要性。结果也强调了良好锚定的预期对于促进宏观经济价格稳定的必要性。

articles.title_en: From trade reform to trade war: a quantitative analysis of China’s current account
articles.title_cn: 从贸易改革到贸易战：中国经常账户的量化分析
articles.abstract_en: This paper quantifies the macroeconomic effects of two pivotal trade events: China’s post-WTO accession liberalization and the recent U.S.-China trade war, which can be viewed as a reversal of the former. We develop a two-country general equilibrium model, disciplined by disaggregated firm-level data, to account for the persistent effects of China’s early-2000s trade reform. Our analysis reveals that the delayed and hump-shaped trajectory of China’s current account between 2001 and 2010 is largely attributable to the asymmetric nature of its liberalization. We find that the reform increased social welfare by 16.4% in China and 2.7% in the rest of the world. Finally, we employ our quantitative framework to simulate the recent U.S.-China trade conflict, quantifying the impacts of both tariff increases and a broader rise in trade costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文量化了两个关键贸易事件的宏观经济效应：中国加入WTO后的自由化以及最近的中美贸易战，后者可视为前者的逆转。我们构建了一个两国一般均衡模型，以企业层面的分类数据为约束，来解释中国2000年代初贸易改革的持续影响。我们的分析揭示，中国在2001年至2010年间经常账户的延迟和驼峰形轨迹主要归因于其自由化的不对称性。我们发现，改革使中国的社会福利提高了16.4%，世界其他地区提高了2.7%。最后，我们运用我们的量化框架模拟了最近的中美贸易冲突，量化了关税增加和更广泛的贸易成本上升的影响。

articles.title_en: Designing optimal progressive taxation under hours constraints
articles.title_cn: 工时约束下的最优累进税制设计
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effects of hours constraints on optimal progressive tax structures. To this end, we present a heterogeneous-agent model with a nonlinear progressive tax system. As a form of hours constraints, we introduce a wage penalty for those working below 40 hours per week, generating a realistic distribution of work hours predominantly concentrated at 40 hours. Our findings indicate that optimal tax progressivity should be significantly higher than the current level. Poor households benefit from the reform, while the rich experience welfare losses, primarily due to productive households being unable to adjust their labor supply under hours constraints. The optimal tax reform reduces overall inequality, albeit at the cost of decreased economic activity. Uncovering the Pareto weights in the social welfare functions, under the current tax system, the weight assigned to the richest households is approximately twice the average.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了工时约束对最优累进税制结构的影响。为此，我们提出了一个具有非线性累进税制的异质性主体模型。作为工时约束的一种形式，我们对每周工作低于40小时的情况引入工资惩罚，从而产生一个现实的工作小时分布，主要集中在40小时。我们的研究结果表明，最优税收累进性应显著高于当前水平。贫困家庭从改革中受益，而富人则经历福利损失，这主要是由于在工时约束下，生产性家庭无法调整其劳动供给。最优税收改革减少了总体不平等，尽管以经济活动减少为代价。在现行税制下，揭示社会福利函数中的帕累托权重，最富有家庭被赋予的权重约为平均水平的两倍。
